# 1.0.6 beta 1

This beta is newer than the stable 1.0.5 release and supersedes the earlier 1.0.5 beta.

- System-aware Dark, Light and System themes, with a deliberate Light palette across the interface.
- UI scaling from 80–150% in 5% steps, with presets, live preview and reset.
- Follow system, Reduced and Full motion preferences.
- Ten complete interface languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Russian, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.
- Bundled Noto Sans CJK fonts for Japanese and Simplified Chinese, and localized installer, runtime, diagnostics and Steam status text.
- Existing settings migrate to schema 4 with backups. Backend names, version strings, raw command/git output and release notes remain in their original form.

The stable archive remains version 1.0.3; this is the newest beta build.
